text:
alice: Heads-up — starting a short check-in on calibration probe curation for the quant bakeoff. Goal: ~5k probes (stratified) + anchors. Need quick buy-in on strata, sampling rules, and deployment mapping.

ben: 👍 can we get a concise schema? i.e., length buckets, modalities, languages?

alice: Proposal: major strata = instruction, conversational, code, math/structured, KB-lookup, multi-step reasoning, hallucination-prone. Within each strata split by token-length buckets: short (<32 tokens), medium (32-128), long (128+). Keep ~10% non-en (es/fr/zh) for language coverage.

carol: Also require negative controls: nonsense prompts, truncations, shuffled words, and paraphrase adversaries. These help detect brittle quant errors.

dmitri: Important: create per-backend anchor subsets. We'll have identical anchor IDs for FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ runs so diffs are deterministic. Use seed=42 everywhere.

eva: For the 5k target, suggested split (rough): 800 instruction, 800 conversational, 600 code, 500 math, 500 kb-lookup, 500 multi-step, 300 hallucination-probe, plus 1000 negatives/adversarial/edgecases. Anchors: 200 gold-reviewed.

ben: On prompt templates — we'll vary system message formats and few-shot vs zero-shot. For evals: deterministic settings (temp=0, top_p=1). For calibration experiments we may sweep temp in [0,0.2], but keep baseline runs at 0.

carol: snippet for sampling (pseudo):
```
# sample_probes.py usage
python sample_probes.py --pool probes.jsonl --strata instruction,code,math \
  --per-strata 500 --length-buckets 32,128 --seed 42 --out calib_set_1969999999.jsonl
```

alice: Anchor suite = 200 human-reviewed items with gold outputs (kept out of training corpora). We'll use anchors for regression alerts and per-strata severity checks.

qa-bot: Reminder: evaluation metrics to log per-probe: exact-match (EM) where applicable, BLEU for short generation tasks, token-level perplexity, and semantic similarity (SBERT cosine). Record per-probe delta vs float baseline and tag probes where delta > 1% absolute.

dmitri: Threshold proposal: INT8 acceptable if overall EM drop <= 1.5% and no single strata drop > 3.0%. AWQ acceptable if overall <= 2.0%. For FP8 require <= 1.0% but check variability on math/code. These are soft; flag for review rather than auto-block.

eva: Deployment profiles mapping (proposal):
- Hosted (low-latency): favor AWQ fallbacks + smaller batches; strict latency SLOs.
- Dedicated (predictable throughput): prefer INT8 with tuned batching/kv-cache.
- Private/on-prem: allow FP8 for customers who opt in and hardware supports it.

ben: Where to store? s3://redwood-evals/calib/1969999999/ — include metadata file with schema and sampling params. Naming: calib/<date>-<model>-<quant>-v1.jsonl.

alice: Metadata required per probe: id, strata, length_bucket, lang, source, seed, prompt_template, anchor_flag(true/false), expected_output (for anchors).

carol: I'll assemble the initial probe pool from: community-qa dumps, internal support logs (anonymized), code snippets from public repos, math problems from benchmarks, and synthetic paraphrases. Aim to have 12k pool so sampling can produce varied calibs.

dmitri: Evaluation infra notes: run float baseline -> save logits + outputs -> run quant variants with same request traces and seeds -> compute diffs. Ensure tokenization parity (use identical tokenizer version).

eva: For bakeoff runs we should capture system metrics too: tail latency P95/P99, memory/GPU utilization, and cost per 1k tokens. That will help correlate accuracy delta with deployment profile.

ben: Quick Q: Do we keep chain-of-thought (CoT) style probes? they tend to explode token length and may be sensitive to quant noise.

alice: Include CoT but mark as a separate sub-strata. Flagging required since CoT reasoning may need higher precision. Keep smaller sample (~200).

qa-bot: Automation checklist:
- generate pool -> sample calib set -> upload to S3 -> run baseline -> run quant runs (FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ) -> generate per-probe diff report -> create per-strata summary + ROI table -> post results to #eng-ml.

carol: I'll start pool build and push probes.jsonl to the s3 path by EOD. tagging owners: carol(pool), ben(sampling infra), dmitri(eval infra), eva(deployment mapping), alice(overall).

alice: Perfect — small follow-ups: 1) keep anchor gold review separate (assign 2 reviewers), 2) include a tiny human eval set (~100) for subjective quality checks, 3) version all sampling seeds.

ben: ack. will add sampling job and CI check that ensures seed fixed and tokenization hash matches.

carol: cc @alice @dmitri — starting now. will post first sample manifest when done.

alice: thanks all :rocket:
